info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Banking Enterprise Services Fixed Asset Registers-v5-spec
info.description: The Retrieve Fixed Asset Registers API provides access to detailed information regarding fixed asset registers managed by an enterprise banking service. This endpoint enables users to fetch a list of fixed assets, which are critical for financial reporting and asset management. Typical consumers include accountants, financial analysts, and operational managers seeking comprehensive insights into asset inventories. By using this API, organizations can efficiently oversee and evaluate their fixed asset portfolios, facilitating better asset tracking and management decisions.

get.description: Fetches the complete list of fixed assets recorded in the enterprise's asset register, allowing users to view and manage their fixed assets effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to query the Fixed Asset Register for enterprise services. It enables clients to specify the parameters for retrieval, such as specific asset IDs or filter criteria.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the fixed asset register.
